set.body: Atomically integrate explicit registry into StudioDocument/ScienceContent validation, conditional schema rungs and all reducer rebuilds. Existing draft owner derives solely from saved base; newly saved revision assigned atomically. Before any multi-family document can decode, scope completed-run supersession, shown-result banners/recipe diffs and family-relative activity to ownership; global jobs indicator may remain global with truthful wording. DatasetMoved keeps existing project-global latest-admitted-dataset policy. Adversarial interleaved A/B runs, ownership survives edits/undo, exact legacy bytes/digests/checkpoints, earlier codecs refuse relabelled family payloads. Creation UI remains unavailable.
set.title: S7.7b2 Family persistence with safe interpretation
